new_observation.summary: Observation-versus-claim evaluation reported 39/40 expected-kind agreement across five same-session passes. The only instability was wording that could denote either inspectable architecture state or a broader architectural interpretation. The experiment recommends retaining observation and claim and shifting experimental pressure toward deterministic validation rather than adding another proposition kind.

write_safety_incident.issue: An attempted architect_notes append used an incomplete replacement payload and deleted prior append-only history.
write_safety_incident.note: The failed append is not claimed as a durable Architect note. The bad commit remains in Git history as audit evidence; the current architect_notes file is restored exactly to its verified pre-incident blob.
